outreach.notes: Chosen as the Expo 2027 LOGISTICS PARTNER (framework agreement, RSD 530.88m ex-VAT, 15 months Oct 2026–Dec 2027): flows of vehicles, goods, materials and equipment to/from the Surčin site, customs warehouse, delivery coordination, staff + machinery, logistics software, temperature-controlled storage. Majority-owned by Pošta Slovenije. Gatekeeper-grade: every exhibitor's freight passes through them. Source: b92 2026-09-01.
